Package index

Honeycomb plots

The main layer functions for drawing honeycomb waffle charts. geom_honeycomb() is the primary entry point; stat_honeycomb() is available for advanced use with custom geoms.

geom_honeycomb()
Honeycomb waffle chart
stat_honeycomb()
Compute honeycomb layout statistics

Scales and themes

Honey-inspired discrete color scales and a minimal ggplot2 theme designed to complement honeycomb plots.

scale_fill_honey() scale_color_honey()
Honey-inspired discrete scales
honey_pal()
Honey-inspired palette
theme_honeycomb()
Minimal theme for honeycomb plots

Hex grid utilities

Internal helpers for hex grid geometry and compactness scoring. Documented for reference; not exported.

hex-geometry
Hex grid geometry helpers
hex-compactness
Hex region compactness utilities
